changes: Facts checked, only a judgment left (e.g. escalate or not): the analysis is sent right away and only that judgment comes to you as a card
Held for you: nothing is sent to them (no "我需要和…确认" / "我会转给…处理" lines). A private topic still gets the polite decline; small talk Butler's own words; an agreed proposal a 👍
No decline line either ("这个我不方便透露…"): a guarded topic is silence + a card for you. Only small talk is answered while waiting
Three outcomes only: can't answer / your call → nothing sent, a card for you; can answer → answered and you are told; partly → the checked facts + "其余已转告 <you>，稍后回复", a card for the rest
First version: close what shipped, draft comments, hand tickets to their owners, list what needs you
Engineering follow-up (no task / PR, engineering done, no fixVersion) only for product issues in the sprint running now — not the backlog, past or future sprints
First version: how to read a product team's Jira
Reaching Jira without Stargate: ./hive jira search / get / transitions / me
